question: Which district has the denser paved road network, Lindenmoor or Redfen, and by how many km of road per square kilometre?

samples.answer:
Lindenmoor’s paved road density is \(402.3 \div 1,015.7 = 0.396\) km/km². Redfen’s is \(244.6 \div 677.1 = 0.361\) km/km². The difference is \(0.035\) km/km², so Lindenmoor is denser.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035

Lindenmoor: \(402.3 \div 1,015.7 = 0.396080...\) km/km².

Redfen: \(244.6 \div 677.1 = 0.361304...\) km/km².

Difference: \(0.396080... - 0.361304... = 0.034776...\) km/km², so Lindenmoor is denser.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035

Lindenmoor: 402.3 ÷ 1,015.7 = 0.396182 km/km².  
Redfen: 244.6 ÷ 677.1 = 0.361308 km/km².  
Difference: 0.396182 − 0.361308 = 0.034874 km/km², which rounds to 0.035.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 0.035
